question: Contá los proveedores (UEI distintos) cuyo nombre coincide con el nombre o un alias de una empresa u organización de la Lista Consolidada de Control, sin tener en cuenta mayúsculas, puntuación ni formas societarias (Inc., LLC, Corp.).

attempts.query:
WITH csl_nombres AS (
  SELECT e.name AS n FROM csl.entry e WHERE e.type = 'Entity'
  UNION
  SELECT a FROM csl.entry e, unnest(e.alt_names) a WHERE e.type = 'Entity'
),
csl_norm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(n), '[.,'']', '', 'g'), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g'), '\m(inc|llc|corp|corporation|incorporated|co|company|ltd|limited|lp|llp|plc)\M', ' ', 'g'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS k
  FROM csl_nombres WHERE n IS NOT NULL
),
prov AS (
  SELECT r.uei, btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(r.name), '[.,'']', '', 'g'), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g'), '\m(inc|llc|corp|corporation|incorporated|co|company|ltd|limited|lp|llp|plc)\M', ' ', 'g'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS k
  FROM usaspending.recipient r WHERE r.uei IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.uei)
FROM prov p JOIN csl_norm c ON c.k = p.k
WHERE p.k <> ''
